jobs.description: Are you passionate about electronics, testing and automation, and eager to make a direct impact on the quality and manufacturability of high-tech products? Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. In this role, you will develop and implement production test solutions for advanced electronic systems, ensuring products meet the highest quality standards before entering serial production. This employer designs and manufactures highly advanced electronic systems for demanding industries such as semiconductors, industrial, automotive, medical and defense. As a Production Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bridging product development and manufacturing by designing, developing and maintaining production test solutions. You will work closely with hardware, embedded software and manufacturing teams to ensure products can be efficiently and reliably tested throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include: Developing production test strategies and test sequences for electronic products. Designing test hardware, including PCB-based test interfaces, fixtures and measurement circuits. Developing and maintaining automated test software using Python and C++. Performing Design for Testability (DfT) reviews during product development. Designing and maintaining automated production test setups. Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. Performing root cause analysis on production and test failures. Improving test coverage, production yield, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive gross salary in the range of € 3.500 – €5.500 per month excluding 8% holiday allowance, depending on experience, technical expertise and results. Relocation package from Xelvin (see onboarding & benefits).27 paid holidays in addition to public holidays, pension scheme and travel allowance. Holiday allowance of 8% of annual salary. A job with perspective. After the Xelvin contract you will be offered a direct contract with your employer. Career-oriented education, training and development opportunities. Excellent primary and secondary employment conditions. Onboarding & Benefits Your first house in the Netherlands will be arranged by Xelvin, with the help of our relocation team. Furthermore: A relocation assistance allowance will be paid to cover the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and taken to your new home. Onboarding support: assistance with setting up a Dutch bank account, health insurance, BSN registration, dentist and GP registration and other practical matters. We organize several social gatherings throughout the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. Functie-eisen To succeed in this role, you bring: Mandatory Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Electronics / Electrical Engineering only). Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics. Experience designing electronic circuits and printed circuit boards. Must have: Proven experience with Altium Designer. Experience developing test solutions for electronic products. Experience working with laboratory and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQs and signal generators. Experience within electronics manufacturing, semiconductor, embedded systems or power electronics environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent communication skills in English. Some experience with Python and/or C++ (basic). Preferred Experience with automated test systems and production environments. Experience with Design for Testability (DfT). From researching potential clients to supporting sales campaigns and commercial initiatives, you will gain valuable hands-on experience while learning how sales contribute to hotel success.This internship starts in February 2027 and offers a full-time learning experience for 6 to 10 months, aligned with your study requirements.Responsibilities• Provide day-to-day administrative support to the sales team• Assist in identifying and researching potential new clients using online tools and databases and assist in the first steps of outreach• Support the coordination of trade fairs, client events, and sales campaigns by preparing materials, managing logistics, and assisting with follow up• Conduct basic market research to support sales strategyEssential Requirements• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree programme, preferably in Hotel or Hospitality Management• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Dutch• Passionate about hospitality, guest service, and commercial strategy• Strong interpersonal, communication, and organisational skills• Available to work up to 38 hours per week for a minimum of six month

Warehouse Worker (NL work permit required)  16 - 40 uur per week  Tussen €14,99 en €16,68 per uur Beschrijving Wat ga je precies doen As a warehouse worker at GLS in Utrecht, you will contribute to the seamless handling of packages in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. Your role is vital in ensuring that parcels are processed efficiently and delivered on time, all while maintaining safety and quality standards. This position offers you the opportunity to stay active, develop new skills, and work in a team that values innovation and teamwork. What You Will Do: - Loading and unloading: safely handle packages according to established guidelines to ensure smooth operations. - Scanning and sorting: accurately process goods, including minis and NOCOs, with attention to detail. - Inspecting: check packages for irregularities and hazardous materials (ADR) to maintain compliance with safety standards. - Maintaining workspace: keep your area clean, organized, and safe to support efficient workflows. - Adapting: take on various tasks within the warehouse as needed, showcasing your flexibility and teamwork. Wat bieden we jou At GLS, we value your hard work and dedication by offering a benefits package designed to support your professional growth and personal well-being. Here's what you can look forward to when joining our team: - Hourly wage: €14.99 gross, with shift bonuses excluded. - Temporary contract with the possibility of permanent employment. - Flexible working hours: 16-40 hours per week. - Travel cost reimbursement and on-site parking availability. - Opportunities to gain new skills, such as EPT certification. - A dynamic, supportive, and collaborative work environment.
